value: In src/lib.rs, sorensen_dice filters whitespace and forms Unicode char bigrams, but uses String::len() for the fewer-than-two check and denominator. String::len() counts UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII inputs produce inflated totals and inconsistent scores; for éa versus éab the denominator becomes byte-based instead of the three scalar-value bigrams. The existing HashMap decrement logic preserves duplicate multiplicity, and the equal-input early return plus whitespace filtering and ASCII behavior remain unchanged. The proposed repair derives filtered scalar counts with chars().count() and uses them in the length guard and denominator, preserving the public API and helper.
